column1: # APK name <TAB> source folder, for the apps whose folder was renamed after the APK had shipped (2026-11-18: the
# shared apps of every model lost their misleading Z9x prefix). The APK name stays everywhere it is a file name: the
# install path on every projector (/system/priv-app/Z9xHome/Z9xHome.apk, kept so updates replace the same file),
# the pins in overlay/apps_v1, stage/ and signed_stage/, the recipes' app lines and device.conf apps lists.
# Every other app lives in apps/<APK name>. Read by tools/devices/assemble_app.py app_dir (also --app-dir NAME for
